description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity 'LoaderRetained' demonstrating the use of a CursorLoader with a ListFragment to load and display contacts with search functionality. It includes internal classes for the fragment and a custom SearchView.

classes.name: LoaderRetained
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating usage of Loader and Frame management.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays contacts from the device's contact list, supports search filtering, and uses a CursorLoader.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom SearchView subclass that clears its query when collapsed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, manages fragment creation.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter, loader, and search UI components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the search menu and sets up the SearchView.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the search query, restarts loader with new filter.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles closing of the SearchView, resets search query.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates and returns a CursorLoader with optional filtering.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in the new Cursor when loading is complete.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Removes cursor when loader is reset.

methods.name: MySearchView
methods.description: Custom SearchView that clears its query when collapsed.
